# This hangar

`CLAUDE.md` beside this file says how a hangar works and is the same in every one. This file says
which hangar this is, and every value in it comes from `hangar.config.yaml`.

| | |
| -------------------- | --- |
| hangar root          | /Users/someone/code/dvb_gn |
| hangar id            | dvb_gn |
| repo                 | git@bitbucket.org:acme/storefront_ui.git |
| default branch       | master |
| clone directories    | `clone_<NN>`, at least 2 digits — e.g. `clone_01` |
| app subdirectory     | `angular/` |
| secrets              | `/Users/someone/code/dvb_gn/.env.shared` (mode 600) |
| shared plans         | `/Users/someone/code/dvb_gn/plans` |
| shared tmp           | `/Users/someone/code/dvb_gn/tmp` |
| issue keys           | `DN-…` |

**Which clones exist is in no file, this one included.** They are whatever `clone_<NN>`
directories are there; index gaps are normal, because `hangar remove-clone` never renumbers —
renumbering would move another clone's ports out from under a running server. `hangar list` is
the only answer, and `git -C clone_01 branch --show-current` the only answer about a branch.

## Ports

Every clone's ports are a pure function of its index:

    port = base + 0 + (index - 1) * 100

| role | env var | base | URL |
| ---- | ------- | ---- | --- |
| Angular dev server | `NG_DEV_SERVER_PORT` | 4200 | `http://localhost:{port}` |
| Storybook | `STORYBOOK_DEV_SERVER_PORT` | 6006 | `http://localhost:{port}` |
| Playwright HTML report | `PLAYWRIGHT_REPORT_PORT` | 9323 | `http://localhost:{port}` |

The offset is this hangar's residue class mod 100, and that is the whole
guarantee: two hangars with different offsets can never collide for any clone counts, unlike a
reserved block, which fails silently once a hangar outgrows it. **Never hard-code a port and never
assume a server on a default port is yours** — `hangar ports` is the answer for the fleet, and
each clone's own `CLAUDE.local.md` names its own.

## Symlinks every clone carries

Targets are shown AS DECLARED: `{secretsFile}`, `{index2}` and the rest are rendered per clone.

- `tests/playwright-regression-tests/.env.local` → `{secretsFile}` — the tracked tests/.env sets USER_READWRITE_PASSWORD= (empty) and direnv loads it AFTER .envrc.private, so this reload is what wins; delete it and Playwright logs in with an empty password
